title: feat: enhance Page/Canvas Editor & Dashboard Editor with WYSIWYG capabilities
body:
Adds undo/redo, JSON schema sync, preview mode, i18n, keyboard navigation, and mobile responsiveness to `DashboardEditor` and `PageCanvasEditor`.

### DashboardEditor
- Undo/redo via `useUndoRedo` hook + Ctrl+Z/Y keyboard shortcuts
- JSON export/import toolbar (`onExport`/`onImport` callbacks)
- Preview mode toggle rendering `DashboardPreview` panel
- Widget layout size editing (w/h inputs) in property panel
- Delete/Backspace removes selected widget

### PageCanvasEditor
- Page/Dashboard mode tab switcher (`role="tablist"`, `aria-selected`)
- Undo/redo, JSON export/import, preview mode (same pattern as dashboard)
- Delete/Backspace removes selected component

### Shared
- Full i18n via `useDesignerTranslation` — zero hardcoded UI strings
- 16 new keys across all 10 locales (en, zh, ja, de, fr, es, ar, ru, pt, ko)
- Mobile responsive: `flex-col` → `sm:flex-row`

### Usage

```tsx
<DashboardEditor
  schema={dashboardSchema}
  onChange={setSchema}
  onExport={(s) => downloadJson(s)}
  onImport={(s) => console.log('imported', s)}
/>

<PageCanvasEditor
  schema={pageSchema}
  onChange={setSchema}
  onExport={(s) => downloadJson(s)}
/>
```

### Tests
- DashboardEditor: 10 → 22 tests (undo/redo, export/import, preview, layout size)
- PageCanvasEditor: 9 → 23 tests (mode tabs, undo/redo, export/import, preview)
- 206 designer tests, 62 i18n tests — all passing
